title: [MAIN]-Fix-Bug 644909 Cant modify Item Template after Item deletion
summary: Item Template validation no longer fails with warehouse entry errors when modifying templates after item deletion. The fix prevents warehouse entry checks when validating temporary blank-numbered Item records.
key_points: Item.TestNoWhseEntriesExist now exits immediately for blank Item numbers
Resolves validation errors when updating Item Templates after deleting items
Regression test added covering the deleted-item template-update scenario
Fix applied to Item table across all regional localization layers
Warehouse entry queries skipped for temporary blank records used in template validation
quote: Modifying an Item Template after deleting an item could fail with a warehouse-entry validation error.
